claim_one_line: THE VEV PICTURE SCOUTED (control PASSED: Freudenthal 1951, Tits 1953, Rozenfeld 1954, Jacobson 1968, Springer-Veldkamp 2000, Baez read from LaTeX source, plus INSPIRE's E6 GUT classics; zbMATH/arXiv/OpenAlex/INSPIRE reached, MathSciNet 302 and Semantic Scholar 429 NOT reached). (1) THE ANSWER THAT CHANGES OUR SELF-ASSESSMENT: THE VEV DIRECTION IS ALWAYS AN INPUT and no framework derives it -- group theory derives the finite MENU of breakings (Michel/Kim orbit-space geometry) and the potential's FREE PARAMETERS pick a point off it. So 'the object does not supply a VEV' is NOT a defect peculiar to this object: NOBODY'S OBJECT SUPPLIES ONE. B952/B959/B960 recorded the missing VEV as THE gap between the object and the SM; the gap is real but it is THE SAME GAP EVERY GUT HAS, and the programme should stop describing it as its own shortfall. (2) A NO-GO THE PREVIOUS PANEL MISSED -- THE ROUTE STOPS ONE STEP SHORT: B955 said E6 -> SU(5) via two rank-1 27 VEVs reaches rank 4 with the 27 still complex and that the group theory is therefore NOT the obstruction; that was right about the first step and WRONG ABOUT THE DESTINATION. 27 VEVs CAN NEVER BREAK SU(5) -> THE STANDARD MODEL, re-derived in-sandbox: 27 -> 10 + 5 + 5bar + 5bar + 1 + 1 under SU(5), THERE IS NO 24, and the only hypercharge-neutral directions in the 27 are SU(5) SINGLETS which break nothing -- corroborated verbatim in the E6SSM literature ('one cannot break E6 in a conventional manner as the required Higgs fields are in larger representations than the 27'). So the VEV route delivers rank 4 AND chirality and then PROVABLY STOPS ONE STEP SHORT of the SM; B955's 'the group theory is not the obstruction' MUST BE AMENDED -- it is not an obstruction to rank 4, but there IS a further obstruction one step down. (3) A STRUCTURAL REFRAMING: the 27 has exactly THREE nonzero orbits labelled by Jordan rank -- rank 3 GENERIC, OPEN, FULL MEASURE with stabilizer F4; rank 2 intermediate; rank 1 CLOSED, MINIMAL, MEASURE ZERO with stabilizer Spin(10). THE GENERIC VEV'S STABILIZER IS F4, WHICH IS PRECISELY THE PROGRAMME'S ALREADY-PROVED CHIRALITY-KILLING OBSTRUCTION (B953/B954/B959). So the F4 wall is NOT a separate fact about theta -- IT IS WHAT A GENERIC VEV DOES -- and chirality survives only on the MEASURE-ZERO rank-1 orbit; since a single 27 VEV can never deliver both rank 4 and a complex 27, TWO VEVS ARE FORCED, not a modelling preference. A genuine unification of two things the programme had treated as unrelated. (4) NO CANONICAL CHOICE, AND THE ONE EXCEPTION: OP^2 = F4/Spin(9) with transitivity CONSTRUCTED not asserted (independently confirmed by Miyasaka-Yokota's constructive diagonalization), strengthened to FRAMES -- F4 is transitive on TRIPLES of orthogonal primitive idempotents, so the TWO-VEV CONFIGURATION is also homogeneous, closing the 'maybe the pair is canonical' escape. A canonical point of a homogeneous space exists only if the space is a point, so choosing a VEV is unavoidably a CHOICE with no canonical answer -- over R or C. THE ONE EXCEPTION AND THE LIVE OPENING: over Z or a NUMBER FIELD homogeneity FAILS, and Kato-Yukie classify RATIONAL ORBITS OF PAIRS OF 27s BY CUBIC ETALE ALGEBRAS. This programme is arithmetic and owns cubics (mu the charge cubic, kappa the compact cubic, K = Q[rho]/mu), so a classification of two-27 configurations by cubic etale algebras points directly at banked structure -- and it is UNWORKED. Registered L138 as the single live opening. (5) NULLS: Q3 CERTIFIED -- complete citation-graph closure on Elkies-Gross (OpenAlex W2995339545, ALL 39 citers read individually) returns ZERO GUT/Higgs papers, with the instructive detail that the physics citers are all black-hole charge-orbit papers where the 27 is a QUANTIZED CHARGE so integrality is physically forced: the arithmetic-27 idea exists in physics but has NEVER touched a VEV. NOT certified: MathSciNet unreachable, Semantic Scholar rate-limited. (6) CORRECTIONS AND TRAPS: the stabilizer of a rank-1 VECTOR is Spin(10) while of the rank-1 LINE it is (Spin(10)xU(1))/Z4, so sources saying SO(10)xU(1) answer a different question; Baez's 'collineations fixing a point = Spin(9,1)' names the LEVI'S SEMISIMPLE PART, not the 62-dimensional full isotropy group; a SUSY tension is flagged since pure group theory gives rank 4 from two 27 VEVs while SUSY D-flatness pairs 27/27bar and the literature stalls at RANK 5 (consistent, the E6SSM wants a TeV Z', but a seat quoting 'rank 4' in a SUSY context will be contradicted); and DO NOT CITE, could not be located: Buccella-Ruegg-Savoy 'Rank 5 and 6 subgroups of E6' and any Babu-Bajc-Saad E6 paper.
